preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have owner privileges transferred to them

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, exploit the excessive privileges by calling: 1) setFees() to modify trading fees up to 50%, 2) manage_blacklist() to blacklist user addresses preventing them from trading, 3) clearStuckBalance() to withdraw all BNB held by the contract, 4) tradingStatus() to halt trading, 5) setFeeReceivers() to redirect all fee payments to attacker-controlled addresses, 6) setMultipliers() to increase sell fees up to 200%. The owner has unrestricted control over all critical contract parameters including fees, trading status, blacklists, exemptions, and fund withdrawal capabilities.
